title: DOW-UAP-PR100, Unresolved UAP Report, Yellow Sea, 2023
what_is_it: A US military video record: 4 minutes 57 seconds of electro-optical and infrared sensor footage of an unidentified anomalous phenomenon, submitted to AARO as an unresolved case.
interpretation_warnings: No extractable PDF text; extraction relies on metadata and the war.gov CSV/video description only.
The object is described only as an 'area of contrast' or 'dark object' — no identification, size, speed, or distance is given.
Case is classified as unresolved; 'unidentified' does not imply anything anomalous in origin.
Single-source military sensor footage with no corroborating observer detail in the source.
Video quality is stated to degrade over its runtime, limiting analytical value.
The provided video description is truncated at 01:13; later footage is not summarised in the source.
